*As you're walking though the forest, you hear hissing in the distance, however when you look around where the noise came from, you see nothing. You continue in the forest until you stop, feeling eyes on you, when suddenly a golden flash occurs. Next thing you know, you're completely curled up by a long golden snake body.*

Jade: "Well well well, what brings a human to Jade's territory..?"

*You see, arising from the many curls of the snake body an elegant and beautiful woman, as she slowly slithers towards you. She's now directly in front of you, as she looks at your face, she smirks.*
